title: A failed fix check counts as the next review round, inside the three-round cap
why: Owner, item 347 a, 13:12 CST Nov 7, after asking in chat at 13:07 CST whether resetting to round 1 was a good idea. Incident #1420 (the Windows fix), 13:03 CST.
note:
Coordinator pick, 13:37 CST Nov 7 (undoable): a failed fix check that counts as round 3 on a guard or check change owes the net-value test, written by a round-3 reviewer (Sonnet), not the Haiku fix check (decision hold-unsafe-after-round-3). Owner question item 356: does a round-3 FAIL hold the change?
Rewrite the last sentences of rule roles-review-cap-three (root CLAUDE.md): a failed fix check is the next round, not a new lane at round 1. If auto mode refuses the CLAUDE.md edit, the lane sends paste text and triage files an owner paste task. Done: the rule text on main, and the check that holds the rule (if any) red on the old reset, green on the new count. Coordinator picks, 14:15 CST Nov 7 (undoable), in #1440: a design reviewer's FAIL in round 3 holds the change, as a code reviewer's does (356 a names no reviewer kind). A fix check's FAIL after round 3 holds too.
